name: complete-client-server-communication
description: A comprehensive guide to all the ways clients and servers communicate in JavaScript and Node.js

scripts.start:xhr: cd xhr && npm install && node server.js
scripts.start:sse: cd server-side-events && npm install && node server.js
scripts.start:websocket: cd client-server-sockets && npm install && node server.js
scripts.start:tcp: cd server-side-sockets && npm install && node server.js
scripts.start:webrtc: cd webrtc && npm install && node server.js
scripts.start:http3: cd http3 && npm install && npm run generate-certs && node server.js
